title: AMP Datasets and their Harmonization in FAIRplex
bodyHtml:
This table lists human tissue and primary cell datasets available through AMP AD, AMP CMD, AMP PDRD, and AMP RA/SLE. While this represents the current ecosystem of available data for AMP projects included in the Beta harmonization, not all data from these AMP projects are slated to be harmonized in the upcoming production releases, while additional AMP projects will be assessed for inclusion.

The table shows data that were harmonized for the Beta release and data anticipated to be to be included in the production release.

General inclusion criteria for SysBio FAIRplexharmonizationare the following: Datasets with whole genome sequencing (WGS), and/or single cell or single nucleus RNA-seq, and/or bulk RNA-seq, and large scale proteomics on cohorts with transcriptomics available. For more information about harmonization procedures used in the Beta release harmonization, visit here. For information about how to access AMP data, visit here.
